Constraints
* Please change 26 to 10 since [[n]] never exceeds 10.

* Please add a constraint on the range of length of [[s]].

Stub generator
* Instead of 1024, please use the upper bound on the length of [[s]].

Cases
* Please add a pair of cases where [[n]] = 6 and the length of each string is 1.

* Please add a pair of cases where [[n]] = 8 and the length of each stirng is smaller than 8.

* When adding the cases, please try to cover any letters (e.g. m, q) not yet included in the existing cases.

Thanks.
